Product Archetype: SaaS Productivity & Issue Tracker (Linear / Raycast Style)
Keywords: saas, productivity, project management, issue tracker, linear, workspace, b2b, workflow
High-Freq Tier Strategy: 120-160ms max duration; 0.97 tactile press; 0ms input-buffered Cmd+K; physical <kbd> depression; 150ms Coyote Time on menus
Medium-Freq Tier Strategy: Optimistic status toggles; FLIP sliding active pills; Kanban drag lift (scale 1.03) + neighbor knockback; strikethrough sweep on task check
Hero Moment Strategy: Sprint complete / Inbox Zero: 80ms hitstop + subtle 8-spark burst + major triad chime
Recommended Mechanics: anticipation-press + coyote-time-hover-grace + input-buffering-queue + optimistic-choreography + keycap-shortcut-depression + strikethrough-sweep-decay
Audio & Haptic Policy: Opt-in subtle hardware clicks (<=0.03 gain) + combo pitch escalation on batch task completion
Avoid (Anti-Patterns): Slow >300ms entrance animations, bouncy modals, or blocking confirmation dialogs on routine actions

Medium-Freq Tier Strategy: Odometer number roll on balance/price changes; chromatic impact flash on live ticker updates; damped traumaShake on invalid OTP/card input

Medium-Freq Tier Strategy: Add-to-Cart button: anticipation compress -> recoil kickback -> icon morph to Check + cart badge spring pop (scale 1.25 -> 1.0) + odometer subtotal roll

Medium-Freq Tier Strategy: Send button recoil kickback as prompt bubble flies into thread; perimeter border energy beam while generating; blur-to-crisp token chunk materialization

Product Archetype: EdTech, Language Learning & Habit Tracker (Duolingo / Brilliant Style)
Keywords: edtech, learning, quiz, habit tracker, streak, gamification, course, fitness, duolingo
High-Freq Tier Strategy: 3D raised keycap buttons (2px bottom border that depresses to 0px on :active); magnetic snap on drag-and-drop word tiles
Medium-Freq Tier Strategy: Pitch escalation (+1 semitone) on consecutive correct answers; squash & stretch on progress bar; traumaShake on wrong answer
Hero Moment Strategy: Lesson/Streak Complete: 100ms hitstop -> progress bar surge + particle burst + odometer XP roll + harmonic triad fanfare
Recommended Mechanics: keycap-shortcut-depression + pitch-escalation-combo + squash-and-stretch-morph + particle-micro-burst + hitstop-micro-pause + harmonic-chord-confirm
Audio & Haptic Policy: Core pillar of the experience: procedural combo pops, tactile tile clicks, and distinct success/error haptics (with mute toggle in header)
Avoid (Anti-Patterns): Uninterruptible 4-second celebration screens that prevent fast learners from clicking 'Continue' immediately (always support Input Buffering!)

Medium-Freq Tier Strategy: Mechanical detent ticks + visual alignment guide flash when snapping to grid/center; physical lift & velocity tilt when dragging layers; viscous rubber-banding on timeline boundaries
